proof.text: For E in D(A) with E.IsGE 1, use Mathlib DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE to choose an isomorphic strictly >= 1 cochain complex K. Mathlib DerivedCategory.to_singleFunctor_obj_eq_zero_of_injective, at i=0 and n=1, kills every map Q(K) to I[0]. Cancel the representative isomorphism to conclude every map E to I[0] is zero. This is the proved private helper injective_single_from_upper_eq_zero.

Take the canonical distinguished truncation triangle T = tau<1(K) -> K -> tau>=1(K) ->. Its first term is <=0 and its third term is >=1. If two maps f,g:K->I[0] agree after precomposition with T.mor1, then T.mor1 composed with f-g is zero. Triangle.yoneda_exact2 supplies a:T.obj3->I[0] with f-g=T.mor2 composed with a. The previous vanishing gives a=0, hence f=g. Thus restriction to tau<1(K) is injective.

The proved source-library lemma DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor_map_bijective_of_isLE_of_isGE in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.TStructure applies to tau<1(K)<=0 and I[0]>=0. Its injectivity half determines the restricted maps from their H^0 maps. If H^0(f)=H^0(g), precompose this equality by H^0(T.mor1) and use functoriality to obtain equality of H^0 of the restricted maps. Homology injectivity gives equality of the restrictions; restriction injectivity gives f=g. No boundedness or enough-injectives assumption is used.

title: Injectivity of the degree-zero homology map from morphisms into an injective single object.
statement: For an abelian category A with a chosen derived category, K in D(A), and injective I in A, the degree-zero homology map from morphisms K to I[0] to morphisms between degree-zero homology objects is injective.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_homology_injective_injective
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    (K : DerivedCategory A) (I : A) [Injective I] :
    Function.Injective
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A 0).map :
        (K ⟶ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj I) →
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A 0).obj K ⟶
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A 0).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj I)))
